statusScreen.source: Feature report 8 of the Stream Deck module (read 2026-10-18) ends with d0 02 80 01 = 720 x 384 little-endian; galleon-deck docs/PROTOCOL.md and OpenActionAPI/rust-elgato-streamdeck PR #63 give the same size. Confirmed on the hardware: a 720 x 384 JPEG sent by galleond fills the whole screen (2026-10-18).

keys.source: Pixel sizes: feature report 8 holds a0 00 a0 00 = 160 x 160 (read 2026-10-18); galleon-deck gives 160 x 160 JPEG. Grid: report 8 starts with 04 03 and galleon-deck says 3 keys wide and 4 high (rust-elgato-streamdeck PR #63 writes it as 4 x 3: only the orientation of the wording differs, 12 keys). Key and gap sizes in mm: to measure with a ruler.

throughput.source: To measure by sending a burst of images and timing it.
